points.label: Divine response
points.left: The scene includes visions, paradise, and unspeakable words. It also includes boasting, restraint, and thorn. It also includes messenger, repeated prayer, and sufficient grace. It also includes weakness, power, and contentment. Together, these details stay in the same scene.
points.right: Satan returns, Job’s integrity is named, a new limit is set, sores follow, and Job answers his wife.

payload.posture: Read both WEBU passages side by side. Keep each passage’s actors, setting, order, and identity claims distinct.

rightEvidence.title: Satan strikes Job’s body within a life-preserving limit

payload.tension: Both sources name Satan near bodily suffering. They differ in cause, prayer, limit, and answer.
